meta.title: MDCC Request Initiation: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Open or initiate an MDCC Request Initiation request.
Assert that MDCC Request Initiation is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.
Repeat the same MDCC Request Initiation flow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and assert that it is available.
Compare the same Quality Inspector's capability across Growth and Enterprise tenants without named QA company IDs.
